text.arabic_uthmani: ٱلْيَوْمَ تُجْزَىٰ كُلُّ نَفْسٍۭ بِمَا كَسَبَتْ ۚ لَا ظُلْمَ ٱلْيَوْمَ ۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ سَرِيعُ ٱلْحِسَابِ

words.gloss_range: the known day as a fronted accusative time frame for recompense
words.root_gloss_range: day, period, or decisive event-time; locally the judgment day as an arrived execution window
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلْيَوْمَ}} ({{tr:al-yawma}}) comes first, so the reader hears the decisive day before the act of recompense or the persons receiving it. The word is not a neutral date: the known day functions as an arrived event-window in which deferred accountability becomes active. It also opens a repeated temporal bracket with word 10, so recompense and the denial of injustice are held inside one day-frame that continues the dominion scene from 40:16 and recalls the judgment-day field of 1:4.

topics.headline: fronted day governs recompense
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that finality frames the clause before actor, recipient, or action is named.
topics.reason: QAC and attachment evidence identify word 1 as the definite accusative adverbial frame for the passive recompense clause.

topics.headline: known day becomes execution window
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the day is an enacted judgment interval, not a calendar label.
topics.reason: The root field permits day or decisive period, while the local definite adverbial use and judgment setting narrow it to operative event-time.

topics.headline: first half of repeated day bracket
topics.reader_payoff: The reader tracks one temporal enclosure joining recompense, no-injustice, and the prior sovereignty scene.
topics.reason: The second occurrence of the same adverb and the cited echoes support a bracketed judgment-day reading, while local syntax keeps this word attached to the recompense clause.

words.gloss_range: passive recompense or requital measured by the earned basis
words.root_gloss_range: repayment, requital, compensation, and sufficiency; locally enacted due settlement in passive form

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: the earned-basis phrase attached to passive recompense
the grammatically feminine singular self anticipated by the passive verb
the delayed divine name that grounds the passive recompense in the final clause

words.prose: {{ar:تُجْزَىٰ}} ({{tr:tujzā}}) is passive and feminine singular, anticipating {{ar:نَفْسٍۭ}} ({{tr:nafsin}}) while leaving the external agent unspoken until the final divine-name clause. The root field makes recompense a return or due settlement, and {{ar:بِمَا كَسَبَتْ}} ({{tr:bimā kasabat}}) decides its valence by the self's own acquisition. Its position before {{ar:ٱللَّهَ}} ({{tr:Allāha}}) creates a process-to-authority arc: the settlement is presented as already operative, then grounded by swift account, with 45:22 and 14:51 reinforcing the formulaic accountability field.

topics.headline: passive centers the recompensed self
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the self and the settlement before the explicit actor is named.
topics.reason: The verb is IV passive imperfect with 3FS agreement, and the passive subject is the distributed self phrase.

topics.headline: recompense as measured due
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that reward or penalty is determined by the earned content, not by a separate verb choice.
topics.reason: The root range supports return, requital, and sufficiency, while the local prepositional basis phrase narrows the return to earned settlement.

topics.headline: process precedes explicit authority
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the ayah first making recompense unavoidable, then naming the authority who warrants it.
topics.reason: The local word order delays the divine name, and the cited parallels in 45:22 and 14:51 keep recompense and swift account in the same accountability formula.

words.gloss_range: totalizing quantifier in construct with a singular self
words.root_gloss_range: allness, totality, and encompassing coverage; locally exhaustive distributive reach

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: the singular self governed by the totalizing construct
the open relative content marker matched with the universal subject

words.prose: {{ar:كُلُّ}} ({{tr:kullu}}) supplies the first human term after the fronted day and passive verb, but it does so as a construct head bound to singular {{ar:نَفْسٍۭ}} ({{tr:nafsin}}). The result is distributive totality: no self is outside the reach, yet the judged unit is not an anonymous mass. Its scope answers {{ar:مَا}} ({{tr:mā}}): every self faces whatever it earned, matching exhaustive persons with open-ended deed content as in accountability formulas such as 2:281 and 45:22.

topics.headline: every self, not a mass
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that universality is counted one self at a time.
topics.reason: The nominative quantifier is the passive subject head and is bound in construct to singular {{ar:نَفْسٍۭ}} ({{tr:nafsin}}).

topics.headline: totality leaves no outside edge
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees exhaustive reach paired with exact justice rather than collective flattening.
topics.reason: The totalizing field is locally licensed by the quantifier construction, while the following singular complement preserves individual accounting.

topics.headline: every person meets whatever record
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the ayah matching exhaustive recipients with an unrestricted earned-content slot.
topics.reason: The rows connect the universal subject to the open relative phrase, and the cited formulas in 2:281 and 45:22 support the accountability pattern.

words.gloss_range: indefinite singular self as the distributed accountable unit
words.root_gloss_range: self, person, life, and inner being; locally the living bearer of acquisition and recompense

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: the totalizing construct head that individualizes the self
the feminine earning verb that resumes the same self
the no-injustice term protecting the accountable self from wrong

words.prose: {{ar:نَفْسٍۭ}} ({{tr:nafsin}}) is indefinite singular under {{ar:كُلُّ}} ({{tr:kullu}}), so the ayah reaches everyone by treating each self as a separate accountable unit. Its feminine agreement is picked up by {{ar:كَسَبَتْ}} ({{tr:kasabat}}), binding recipient and earner into one referent. The word keeps accountability personal rather than bureaucratic: the self that lived and acquired is the self recompensed, protected from {{ar:ظُلْمَ}} ({{tr:ẓulma}}), and this one-by-one reckoning continues the shift from collective exposure in 40:16.

topics.headline: indefinite singular individualizes reach
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that total judgment reaches people individually, not as an absorbed group.
topics.reason: The word is singular indefinite genitive as the complement of {{ar:كُلُّ}} ({{tr:kullu}}), forcing distributive reference.

topics.headline: recipient and earner are one
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the same self receive the outcome of its own acquired record.
topics.reason: The feminine agreement on the earning verb ties the relative clause back to this self, and the lexical field supports personhood and agency.

topics.headline: liable self is protected self
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that personal liability and protection from wrong attach to the same referent.
topics.reason: The local sequence joins self, earning, and no-injustice, and the cited 2:281 parallel supports the same accountability field.

words.gloss_range: preposition marking the earned content as basis, correspondence, and measure

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: the relative earning clause governed by the preposition
the compact basis formula formed by the bound preposition and relative clause

words.prose: {{ar:بِ}} ({{tr:bi}}) is the hinge that fastens the passive recompense to {{ar:مَا كَسَبَتْ}} ({{tr:mā kasabat}}). It makes the following relative clause the governed basis of payment, not a loose comment after the fact. Its cause-and-correspondence force lets the earned content both explain the recompense and supply its measure, while the bound form creates the compact formula {{ar:بِمَا كَسَبَتْ}} ({{tr:bimā kasabat}}), also echoed in 45:22.

topics.headline: earned content becomes basis
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that recompense is syntactically grounded in what was earned.
topics.reason: The preposition governs {{ar:مَا}} ({{tr:mā}}) and attaches that phrase to the passive recompense verb as its basis.

topics.headline: cause and measure stay attached
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees earned acts not only causing recompense but clinging to it as the matching measure.
topics.reason: The particle rows identify basis, cause, correspondence, and contact senses that are locally coherent because the governed phrase names the earned record.

topics.headline: bound particle forms formula
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the compact accountability formula where recompense and earned acts are fused tightly.
topics.reason: The bundle segmentation splits the preposition, but the grammar still recognizes the compact prepositional phrase used in the 45:22 parallel.

words.gloss_range: relative or nominal content marker: what or whatever was earned

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: the preposition governing the relative content marker
the earning verb carried by the relative marker

words.prose: {{ar:مَا}} ({{tr:mā}}) turns {{ar:كَسَبَتْ}} ({{tr:kasabat}}) into a content-unit governed by {{ar:بِ}} ({{tr:bi}}), allowing the whole deed clause to function as the basis of recompense. It is relative, not interrogative, so there is no uncertainty in the record. Because it remains open as what or whatever, the ayah does not preselect a deed category: every self meets whatever it has acquired.

topics.headline: deed clause becomes object-basis
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices a whole earning clause entering the syntax as the basis for recompense.
topics.reason: QAC treats the particle as relative or nominal, and attachment evidence makes it both the object of the preposition and the object in the relative clause.

topics.headline: whatever was earned remains open
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees no pre-excluded deed category and no excluded self.
topics.reason: The open relative content slot is filled by the perfect earning verb and answers the universal scope of {{ar:كُلُّ}} ({{tr:kullu}}).

topics.headline: relative form excludes uncertainty
topics.reader_payoff: The reader understands the record as available for judgment rather than questioned.
topics.reason: The particle is governed by the preposition inside a basis phrase, so the local use is relative or nominal rather than interrogative.

words.gloss_range: completed acquisition by the self, supplying the record for recompense
words.root_gloss_range: earning, gaining, acquiring, and incurring liability; locally the acquired record that grounds settlement

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: the self whose feminine agreement controls the earning verb
the recompense verb answered by the earned input
the Form VIII contrast mentioned by the 2:286 comparison

words.prose: {{ar:كَسَبَتْ}} ({{tr:kasabat}}) completes the relative clause and locks the basis of recompense to the same {{ar:نَفْسٍۭ}} ({{tr:nafsin}}) by feminine agreement. Its perfect aspect treats acquisition as already entered into the record for this day. The root covers gain and incurred liability, so one broad Form I verb can ground reward or penalty according to the acquired content; this is why {{ar:تُجْزَىٰ}} ({{tr:tujzā}}) and {{ar:كَسَبَتْ}} ({{tr:kasabat}}) form an input-output pair, sharpened by the contrast with {{ar:ٱكْتَسَبَتْ}} ({{tr:iktasabat}}) in 2:286.

topics.headline: the self owns the earning
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the recompensed self as grammatically responsible for the earned basis.
topics.reason: The perfect 3FS verb agrees with the singular self and completes the relative content governed by {{ar:مَا}} ({{tr:mā}}).

topics.headline: gain and liability share one verb
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the same acquisition verb can carry reward or penalty depending on what was acquired.
topics.reason: The root range supports earning, gaining, acquisition, and incurring, and the local basis phrase leaves the earned content to determine valence.

topics.headline: Form I perfect fixes settled acquisition
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees a settled record of direct acquisition rather than ongoing earning or someone causing gain.
topics.reason: The local form is Form I perfect, not an imperfect, causative form, or the Form VIII contrast mentioned in the rows.

topics.headline: earning supplies recompense input
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices judgment as measured response to acquired input, not arbitrary assignment.
topics.reason: The verb completes the basis phrase after {{ar:مَا}} ({{tr:mā}}), and the cited 2:286 contrast keeps broad acquisition in view.

words.gloss_range: categorical negation particle denying the genus of injustice

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: the governed noun whose genus is categorically negated
the no-injustice phrase framed by the repeated day
the later emphatic particle that supplies the warrant for no-injustice

words.prose: {{ar:لَا}} ({{tr:lā}}) starts the middle verdict and governs {{ar:ظُلْمَ}} ({{tr:ẓulma}}) as a categorical negation. Its scope is the no-injustice clause, not the preceding recompense clause, so the ayah adds a second claim after payment: wrong itself has no standing on this day. The brief open sound of {{ar:لَا}} ({{tr:lā}}) resets the cadence before {{ar:ظُلْمَ ٱلْيَوْمَ}} ({{tr:ẓulma al-yawma}}), letting the negated nominal clause sit as a clipped verdict between the two day frames, and the later {{ar:إِنَّ}} ({{tr:inna}}) clause supplies its warrant in God's swift account.

topics.headline: wrong is categorically excluded
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah denies the class of injustice, not merely one act.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence identifies {{ar:ظُلْمَ}} ({{tr:ẓulma}}) as the governed complement of categorical {{ar:لَا}} ({{tr:lā}}).

topics.headline: negation stays within the justice clause
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the no-injustice statement as a clipped central verdict inside the day bracket.
topics.reason: The clause boundary confines negation to {{ar:ظُلْمَ ٱلْيَوْمَ}} ({{tr:ẓulma al-yawma}}), and its position between payment and repeated day gives it central force.

topics.headline: negation leads to emphatic warrant
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the structure moving from excluded wrong to the asserted account that grounds that exclusion.
topics.reason: The ayah places the categorical negation before the emphatic final account clause, creating the stated justice-to-warrant movement.

words.gloss_range: injustice, wrong, diminution, misplacement, or obscured distortion, categorically absent here
words.root_gloss_range: wronging, oppression, misplacement, diminution, and dark obscuring; locally the absence of any distortion in reckoning

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: the categorical negation particle governing the injustice noun
the earned basis that blocks arbitrary displacement

words.prose: {{ar:ظُلْمَ}} ({{tr:ẓulma}}) is the accusative verbal noun governed by categorical {{ar:لَا}} ({{tr:lā}}), so the ayah excludes injustice as a principle rather than narrating that no one performs an unjust act. Its root field adds wrong, diminution, misplacement, and dark obscuring; in an accounting setting, no distortion of measure can enter the reckoning. The claim is reinforced by 40:31 and 4:40, and locally it answers {{ar:كَسَبَتْ}} ({{tr:kasabat}}): since outcome follows what was acquired, it is not arbitrary displacement.

topics.headline: injustice has no standing
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices total exclusion of injustice through the noun governed by categorical negation.
topics.reason: The word is an accusative verbal noun under {{ar:لَا}} ({{tr:lā}}), yielding comprehensive genus negation.

topics.headline: no darkening of the measure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees injustice as any distortion, concealment, diminution, or misplacement in the account.
topics.reason: The broader root field is locally narrowed by accounting context into absence of distorted measure.

topics.headline: wrong is denied as principle
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices a procedural state of no wrong, not merely the absence of a narrated wrongdoer.
topics.reason: The local form is a maṣdar in a verbless negated nominal clause, not an active participle or finite verb.

topics.headline: earned basis blocks arbitrary wrong
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees no-injustice tied to exact recompense by earned acquisition and to the larger divine justice motif.
topics.reason: The cited echoes at 40:31 and 4:40 are compatible with the local no-injustice clause, and the local earned-basis phrase supports measured return.

words.gloss_range: repeated definite time frame for the no-injustice clause
words.root_gloss_range: day, period, or decisive event-time; locally the same operative judgment day renewed around no-injustice

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: the categorical no-injustice clause framed by the repeated day
the following emphatic particle that introduces the explanatory warrant

words.prose: The second {{ar:ٱلْيَوْمَ}} ({{tr:al-yawma}}) locally frames {{ar:لَا ظُلْمَ}} ({{tr:lā ẓulma}}), so no-injustice is timed as sharply as recompense. The repetition renews the same event-day rather than leaving the first frame implicit, making justice an enacted condition of the operative interval. It also closes the middle bracket before {{ar:إِنَّ}} ({{tr:inna}}), so the final clause explains an already bounded scene of payment and no wrong, with 82:19 and the 40:16 boundary reinforcing divine command over that day.

topics.headline: no-injustice is timed locally
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that no-injustice is not detached from the day of recompense.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence makes the second day adverbial to the negated wrong clause.

topics.headline: repetition renews the operative interval
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees justice as a condition enacted inside the same decisive day.
topics.reason: The identical definite adverb is repeated rather than pronominalized or omitted, sustaining the bounded event-time payoff.

topics.headline: day bracket closes before explanation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader tracks the middle claims as one temporal scene before the final divine-account rationale.
topics.reason: The second day closes the middle frame, joins word 1 to word 10, and the cited 82:19 and 40:16 links are compatible with that structure.

words.gloss_range: emphatic/annulling particle introducing the explanatory final nominal clause

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: the governed divine name in the emphatic final clause
the full swift-account predicate asserted by the particle

words.prose: {{ar:إِنَّ}} ({{tr:inna}}) introduces the final nominal clause as an emphatic explanation, not as a loose new statement. It governs {{ar:ٱللَّهَ}} ({{tr:Allāha}}) and places the whole predicate {{ar:سَرِيعُ ٱلْحِسَابِ}} ({{tr:sarīʿu al-ḥisābi}}) under assertion. After the day-frame, recompense, and no-injustice verdict, this particle turns the closing clause into the grammatical warrant: those claims hold because God is swift in account.

topics.headline: emphasis covers the whole predicate
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the entire swift-account predication is confirmed, not just the divine name.
topics.reason: The particle governs the divine name and introduces the nominal clause whose predicate is the swift-account construct.

topics.headline: closure supplies the ground
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the final clause as the reason the preceding judicial scene is reliable.
topics.reason: The strengthened nominal entry follows the no-injustice clause and supplies the final explanatory seal.

words.gloss_range: proper divine name as the governed subject of the emphatic account clause
words.root_gloss_range: divine proper name with worship, dependence, and awe associations; locally the named authority behind reckoning

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: the emphatic particle governing the divine name

words.prose: {{ar:ٱللَّهَ}} ({{tr:Allāha}}) is accusative under {{ar:إِنَّ}} ({{tr:inna}}), so the divine name enters as the subject of the closing explanation rather than as the overt agent of the earlier passive. The proper name blocks a generic deity reading and identifies the specific authority whose account secures exact justice. Because the name is delayed until after recompense and no-injustice are stated, it functions as warrant and disclosure of authority, echoing 14:51 and tying the account to who reckons rather than to an impersonal procedure.

topics.headline: divine name appears as explanatory subject
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that God is named as the warrant of the process after the process has been stated.
topics.reason: The passive leaves its agent unexpressed, while {{ar:ٱللَّهَ}} ({{tr:Allāha}}) is syntactically the governed noun of {{ar:إِنَّ}} ({{tr:inna}}).

topics.headline: named God, not generic deity
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the account grounded in the named divine authority before whom every self stands.
topics.reason: QAC identifies a proper noun, and the root-field rows are coherent as background pressure around worship, dependence, and awe without replacing the proper-name function.

topics.headline: who reckons secures justice
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices justice depending on the reckoning authority, not merely on a procedure called account.
topics.reason: The divine name and account noun close the ayah together, and the 14:51 parallel joins recompense, God, and swift account.

words.gloss_range: swift as a qualitative construct predicate governing the account domain
words.root_gloss_range: quickness, promptness, and rapid movement; locally immediate reckoning without delay

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: the genitive account noun governed by the construct adjective

words.prose: {{ar:سَرِيعُ}} ({{tr:sarīʿu}}) is the predicate of the emphatic clause and the construct head governing {{ar:ٱلْحِسَابِ}} ({{tr:al-ḥisābi}}). This makes the swiftness specific to reckoning, not a vague divine speed. As a qualitative adjective rather than a comparative or finite hastening verb, it presents swift account as a stable attribute of the divine accounting relation. The root's quick-movement field collapses any imagined lag between earned record, reckoning, and recompense; the 14:51 formula and the compact final sound reinforce that immediacy.

topics.headline: swiftness belongs to account
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that speed is specified as speed in reckoning, not an unattached attribute.
topics.reason: The adjective is the predicate and construct head whose genitive complement is the account noun.

topics.headline: no lag from record to outcome
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the account moving immediately from earned record to settled outcome.
topics.reason: The quickness field is locally directed by the construct complement toward reckoning.

topics.headline: stable attribute, not comparison
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices a settled divine accounting capacity rather than one episodic act of hastening.
topics.reason: The local form is a qualitative adjective in a nominal predicate, not a comparative or finite verb.

topics.headline: swift-account formula closes tightly
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the final phrase as a tight closure that energizes the earlier passive recompense.
topics.reason: The 14:51 parallel uses the same swift-account closure after recompense, and the local predicate reaches back to the passive settlement.

words.gloss_range: the definite account or reckoning domain completing the swift-account construct
words.root_gloss_range: counting, reckoning, considering, evaluating, and sufficiency; locally measured settlement of each earned record

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: the full construct phrase completed by the account noun
the earned input measured by the account
the recompense outcome closed by the account

words.prose: {{ar:ٱلْحِسَابِ}} ({{tr:al-ḥisābi}}) completes the construct {{ar:سَرِيعُ ٱلْحِسَابِ}} ({{tr:sarīʿu al-ḥisābi}}), making reckoning the exact domain where swiftness operates. Its definiteness points to the known account of this judgment scene, and its verbal-noun form turns counting and evaluation into an abstract process fit for every self's record. The root field joins calculation, judgment, and sufficiency, so the account is measured settlement, not bare arithmetic; it closes the arc from {{ar:كَسَبَتْ}} ({{tr:kasabat}}) to {{ar:تُجْزَىٰ}} ({{tr:tujzā}}), echoes divine account in 88:26, and resonates with the surah's later account references at 40:27 and 40:40.

topics.headline: the known reckoning domain
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the final speed is anchored to the account itself.
topics.reason: The noun is definite genitive as complement of {{ar:سَرِيعُ}} ({{tr:sarīʿu}}), completing the construct predicate.

topics.headline: reckoning is measured settlement
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees account as evaluative settlement sufficient to resolve each earned record.
topics.reason: The root range includes counting, considering, reckoning, and sufficiency, and the local verbal noun names the accounting process.

topics.headline: account belongs to divine reckoning motif
topics.reader_payoff: The reader places this swift account inside a wider divine-account motif rather than treating it as an isolated closure.
topics.reason: The supplied references connect account with God in 88:26 and with the surah's later reckoning language at 40:27 and 40:40.

topics.headline: record, no-wrong, and account converge
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the full mechanism: earning supplies input, no-injustice removes distortion, and account supplies swift measure.
topics.reason: The final noun closes the movement from earned content through no-wrong into measured settlement.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The passive تُجْزَىٰ, the causal بِمَا كَسَبَتْ, the denial لَا ظُلْمَ, and ٱلْحِسَابِ form one allocation statement.
baseline_models.mechanism: An acquired act is matched to its consequence, counted, and placed on the self that acquired it; denying displacement in time, place, or right makes the settlement exact rather than merely punitive.

activation_trace.role: Action-for-action matching supplies the settlement relation between acquisition and consequence.
Deliberate acquisition supplies what enters the self's side of the settlement.
Putting something in the wrong time or place defines the allocation error explicitly denied.
Counting and reckoning supply the operation that fixes the measured result.

changed_reading.before: Every person receives a general reward or punishment for deeds.
changed_reading.after: Each self receives a measured consequence matched to its own acquisition, with no result misplaced, mistimed, or withheld.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: كُلُّ نَفْسٍ makes the individual self the exhaustive grammatical patient of تُجْزَىٰ.
baseline_models.mechanism: The substitution branch of recompense raises the possibility that something or someone could stand in for another; total inclusion and the exact identity of each self close that route, while the denial of withholding protects each self's own right and liability.

activation_trace.role: Standing in for another supplies the proxy possibility that the focus construction tests and constrains.
Exhaustive enclosure leaves no self outside the settlement.
The thing's own identity fixes the irreducible account-holder.
Withholding a due right supplies the transfer error excluded from the settlement.

changed_reading.before: Each person is present for judgment.
changed_reading.after: Each self is the non-transferable bearer of its own acquired balance; neither liability nor due can be offloaded.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The repeated ٱلْيَوْمَ encloses a universal كُلُّ and the phrase سَرِيعُ ٱلْحِسَابِ.
baseline_models.mechanism: One bounded present contains a total review. Speed cannot mean hurried approximation because total inclusion and the denial of wrong placement constrain it; it is comprehensive oversight without procedural delay.

activation_trace.role: A bounded day supplies the single temporal container, reinforced by repetition.
Complete enclosure makes the review universal rather than selective.
Absence of slowness removes waiting between acquisition and settled account.
Practical oversight supplies a complete review rather than bare arithmetic.
The denied placement error prevents speed from implying imprecision.

changed_reading.after: The entire review is completed within one decisive present, quickly because nothing is omitted or queued, not because scrutiny is abbreviated.

context_deltas.mechanism: The context makes the record fully manifest before and after the focus: exposed persons, covert betrayal, looking eyes, concealed interiors, action-generating chests, and standing witnesses together remove informational latency. This turns swift account into immediate adjudication of already-present evidence.

activation_trace.role: Lack of delay names the procedural consequence of a fully exposed record.
Active oversight is the focus operation sharpened by the surrounding evidence scene.
Complete emergence into view supplies the public state immediately preceding settlement.
A covert breach of trust supplies morally relevant evidence that ordinary observers miss.
The seeing organ localizes concealed conduct in a minute bodily act.
Hiddenness supplies the informational barrier that divine knowledge has already crossed.
The interior source from which actions issue extends the record behind outward behavior.
Present witnessing supplies the public evidentiary endpoint of the account.

structural_cues: 40:16 immediately precedes the focus with universal exposure and the statement that nothing is hidden.
40:19 moves from a covert glance to concealed chests, while 40:51 later stages witnesses standing.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies exposure, concealed micro-conduct, interior sources, and witnesses; I infer that an already-manifest record causes procedural speed without reduced scrutiny. A live alternative is that speed denotes divine capacity alone, with the evidence sequence serving assurance rather than mechanism.

changed_reading.before: The account is fast despite requiring universal review.
changed_reading.after: The account is fast because inward and outward evidence is already present, exposed, and witnessed when settlement begins.

context_deltas.mechanism: Every attempted social transfer fails: an intercessor cannot join the case, followers ask superiors to absorb a share but receive no sufficiency, all parties remain included under judgment, and excuses provide no benefit. The possible proxy sense of recompense is therefore activated negatively.

activation_trace.role: Substitution or standing in for another supplies the precise transfer mechanism that the context repeatedly blocks.
Exact self-identity fixes the account to its bearer.
A helper joining another's case supplies the first denied route of liability transfer.
Following behind supplies the dependency relation used to request relief from leaders.
Sufficiency names the requested capacity to absorb even a portion of another's result.
Total inclusion answers the request: leaders and followers remain inside the same adjudicated field.
Judgment between people fixes separate positions after the failed appeal.
The explicit absence of benefit closes the route of self-rescue through pleading.
Excuse supplies the final attempted substitute for the acquired record.

structural_cues: 40:18 denies an effective intercessor immediately after the focus.
40:47-48 stages followers asking leaders for a share of relief, then answers that all are included and already judged.
40:52 states that excuses do not benefit the wrongdoers.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies failed joining, failed leader-sufficiency, universal inclusion, and useless excuses; I infer that these failures explain why every self is individually recompensed. A live alternative is that the failures describe only this condemned coalition rather than a general account rule.

changed_reading.before: Each self receives its own result, while mediation remains an unexamined possibility.
changed_reading.after: The self's acquired balance is non-transferable: companion, leader, intercessor, and excuse cannot occupy its place in the account.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later paired clauses distinguish two measuring regimes. A bad act is recompensed only by its likeness, making non-injustice an upper bound on adverse return; faithful good is followed by provision without account, leaving generosity unconstrained by strict equivalence.

activation_trace.role: The denied misplacement becomes the constraint that keeps adverse recompense within its proper measure.
Action-for-action recompense repeats the focus operation in the negative clause.
Equivalence supplies the explicit cap and calibration for an adverse result.
An allotted gift shifts the positive clause from repayment language to provision.
Counting is explicitly negated for provision, contrasting bounty with measured adverse settlement.

structural_cues: 40:40 places like-for-like recompense for evil and provision without account for faithful good in one antithetical sentence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies exact likeness on the adverse side and provision without counting on the positive side; I infer that no injustice limits liability but does not limit generosity. A live alternative is that 'without account' means immeasurable abundance while still belonging to the same accounting procedure.

changed_reading.before: Every acquisition receives a uniformly equivalent return.
changed_reading.after: The account is exact where harm could be over-imposed, while positive provision may exceed calculative equivalence without becoming unjust.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah twice pairs superior power with surviving effects. The first sequence ends in seizure for sins; the repeated sequence says the very earnings associated with those effects could not suffice. Acquisitions therefore arrive at the account as traces attributable to the self, not as assets capable of purchasing immunity.

activation_trace.role: Acquired benefit supplies the ambiguous material that can be treated either as wealth or as attributable production.
Practical review reclassifies acquisitions according to their evidentiary relation to the self.
A remaining mark supplies publicly durable evidence of prior power and action.
Culpable acts identify what the first historical evidence set is finally charged against.
The repeated surviving marks connect worldly achievements to the final non-availing earnings.
Failed sufficiency denies that accumulated production can discharge or shield the producer.
The focus root recurs as worldly acquisition that cannot function as protective capital.

structural_cues: 40:21 and 40:82 repeat the travel, greater-power, and آثار frame near opposite ends of the surah.
The first repetition resolves in seizure for sins; the second resolves in the failure of what they earned to avail them.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies durable effects, culpable acts, repeated earnings, and failed sufficiency; I infer that the account reads acquisitions as attributable exhibits rather than ransom. A live alternative is that 40:82 only denies worldly protection and does not assign an evidentiary function to earnings.

changed_reading.before: What the self earned is a balance of deeds or possessions brought to judgment.
changed_reading.after: What the self earned is also the trace that identifies its history; accumulated success enters as evidence and cannot buy release from its own account.

context_deltas.mechanism: The life-stage sequence terminates at an appointed limit and taking of the self, followed elsewhere by return. At the surah's end, belief formed only after direct sight no longer benefits and is placed in a completed historical pattern. The repeated 'today' in the focus can therefore function as account closure: attribution is now settled rather than still editable.

activation_trace.role: The day as a decisive event supplies the closure point rather than a neutral date.
Taking the self marks one route by which the acquisition period ends.
A fixed temporal limit supplies the boundary of the life-stage sequence.
Return after death or witnessed fulfillment carries the closed record back to its adjudicating destination.
The loss of benefit shows that a newly offered response can arrive too late to alter the result.
Heart-settling assent supplies the late entry whose timing is tested.
Direct sight supplies the disclosure event after which assent no longer changes the account.
A pattern that has passed through prior generations frames closure as recurrent rather than improvised.

structural_cues: 40:67 orders bodily stages toward either prior death or an appointed term.
40:77 joins possible death to return, and 40:85 closes the surah with sight-triggered belief that no longer benefits.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a fixed term, taking and return, then non-beneficial belief after sight; I infer an arrow from temporal limit to ledger closure, so 'today' names the point after which attribution is settled. A live alternative is that 'today' conveys rhetorical immediacy without implying a technical cutoff mechanism.

changed_reading.before: Today merely dates when recompense occurs.
changed_reading.after: Today is the closing event at which the self's acquired record stops being revisable and becomes immediately settleable.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the secondary ج ز ز mapping rather than the ordinary recompense target; it remains packet-valid through تُجْزَىٰ, the decisive day, acquisition, and the context's appointed term. It must be rendered as a licensed harvest analogy, never as a claim that the focus verb etymologically means cutting.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The packet's split mapping for تُجْزَىٰ includes a branch for the time when growth has ripened enough to be cut.

activation_trace.role: Ripeness reaching cutting-time supplies the strange harvest image inside the focus verb's split inventory.
A decisive event supplies harvest-day rather than ordinary chronological duration.
Accumulated acquisition supplies what has grown to yield.
The appointed limit supplies the maturity boundary at which accumulation ends.

changed_reading.before: The day is a courtroom settlement of completed deeds.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the day is also harvest-time: each self's accumulated acquisition has reached its limit and is separated out as its own yield.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is branch-distant because the 'front-runners' branch of س ر ع does not ordinarily define سَرِيعُ here; it remains anchored by universal كُلّ, one repeated day, contextual total inclusion, and witnesses standing. Downstream prose should present it only as a process analogy: universal accounting has no privileged front or delayed rear.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: سَرِيعُ stands beside total inclusion inside one repeated temporal frame.

activation_trace.role: Those at the front supply an ordering image that can be negated by universal simultaneous review.
Total enclosure puts every self into the same processing field.
One bounded day supplies a shared temporal window with no serial overflow.
The contextual declaration of total inclusion removes status-based priority between leaders and followers.
Witnesses standing present the whole adjudicative scene at once.

changed_reading.before: Swift account means each case is processed rapidly.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, swift account means there is no queue: no first class of selves advances while another waits outside the universal present.

strongest_changes: Speed became the procedural consequence of a record already exposed down to covert glances and concealed motives.
The self's balance became non-transferable through the repeated failure of intercessor, leader, sufficiency, and excuse.
40:40 revised uniform equivalence into an asymmetry: adverse recompense is capped by likeness while positive provision can exceed counted return.
Repeated historical آثار turned earnings from protective assets into attributable exhibits that cannot purchase immunity.
summary.what_was_special: The whole-surah packet made 40:17 a procedural hinge between total exposure and the collapse of mediation, then echoed its roots in exact-likeness, failed earnings, fixed terms, and late non-beneficial belief. It also preserved two contained branch-distant images: matured harvest and queue-free accounting.
remaining_uncertainties: Whether provision 'without account' lies outside strict equivalence or simply denotes abundance within the same accounting procedure.
Whether the repeated day language marks a formal account cutoff or primarily intensifies present certainty.
The harvest and no-queue models depend on distant branch activations and should remain analogical rather than lexical claims.

reader_a.activated_readings_md: 1. **Private acquisition becomes exact reciprocal return.** `ك س ب/B001` supplies obtaining gain for oneself, while `ج ز ي/B001` supplies recompense matching an act and `ح س ب/B001` counting. The passive recompense converts what was privately acquired into public account. I infer a ledger preserving ownership of action; the ayah reads justice as the return of one’s own acquisitions in measured form.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: The bounded negative recompense and uncounted positive provision in 40:40 correct a possible flat ledger reading: exact account does not exhaust generosity.

reader_a.activated_readings_md: 1. **Acquisition becomes a ledger entry that returns in kind.** Lexically, `ك س ب:B001` is seeking and obtaining gain, `ج ز ي:B001` is recompense matching an act, and `ح س ب:B001` is counting and reckoning. Structurally, the repeated `اليوم` localizes acquisition, matching payment, absence of misplacement, and speed in one scene; 40:16 has removed concealment and 40:18 removes advocacy. Each root supplies a stage in an economy of settlement. The packet gives gain -> matching return -> reckoning; I infer that deeds enter an exact account when acquired. The ayah reads as liquidation of accumulated gains, with speed arising from complete exposure rather than from skipped scrutiny.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: Later 40:40 corrects any flat-ledger reading: bad recompense is capped by likeness, while good provision passes beyond counting.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi sözü herhangi bir uzunluktaki zaman süresi için genişletir ve bazı kullanımlarda devir anlamına geldiğini açıkça belirtir. Dal çerçevesi, sınırlı gündüz anlamından bu geniş zamansal kullanıma geçişi doğru yansıtır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Yalın biçimin belirsiz süre ve devir kullanımı, iki karşıt hayat durumunu anlatan özel söz öbeğinden ayrı tutulur.

facets.statement: Herhangi bir uzunluktaki zaman süresini belirtir ve bilinen gündüz sınırlarına bağlı değildir.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi büyük olay, olayın gerçekleşmesi, şiddetli gün ve çoğulda yaşanmış olaylar kullanımlarını aynı dalda toplar. Bu çerçeve kullanılabilir, ancak bunların tek bir yalın anlam değil, gün ile olay arasındaki aktarmaya dayanan bağlı kullanımlar olduğu açıkça belirtilmelidir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal, büyük veya çetin olayla bağlantılı mecazî ve kalıplaşmış kullanımlarla sınırlıdır; literal zaman süresi ve yalnızca Tanrı'ya bağlanan anma günleri dışarıda kalır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Olayı anlatan biçimsel genişleme, şiddetli gün bildiren kalıplar ve çoğul olay anlamı ayrı yüzler olarak korunur; kalıp anlamları yalın kullanıma genellenmez.

concept_map.definition: Büyük veya çetin bir olayın gerçekleştiği kritik günü ya da olayın kendisini anlatan aktarmalı kullanımdır. Bazı kalıplarda çok ağır bir gün, çoğul biçimde ise yaşanmış önemli olaylar anlamı taşır.

facets.statement: Gün sözü, büyük bir olay gerçekleştiğinde o kritik zamanı veya gerçekleşen olayı anlatmak üzere aktarılır.
Belirli kalıplarda günün çok çetin, ağır ve etkisi uzun süren bir gün olduğu vurgulanır.
Çoğul biçim, bilinen günlerde gerçekleşmiş önemli olayları veya tarihî vakaları anlatabilir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar gün sözünün büyük bir olayın gerçekleşmesine aktarılmasını, çetin gün anlatımında kullanılmasını ve çoğul biçimin olayları belirtmesini aynı anlamsal aile içinde verir.

error_profile.preserves: Bağlamda işaret edilen zamana gönderim işlevini korur.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak sözü, yapılan bir iyiliğe iyilikle, kötülüğe de kötülükle karşılık vermeyi açıkça ortak çekirdek olarak gösterir. Ödül, olumsuz yaptırım ve öç alma bu iki yönlü karşılık ilişkisinin özel görünümleridir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal yalnızca olumlu bir ödülü ya da yalnızca olumsuz bir yaptırımı anlatmaz; karşılığın iki yönünü de kapsar.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım, genel karşılık verme çekirdeğini korurken belirli kalıplara bağlı hızlı öç alma ve hak edilmiş karşılık kullanımlarını ayrı, bağımlı görünümler olarak tutar.

concept_map.definition: Bir kişinin yaptığına, iyiyse iyilikle ve kötüyse kötülükle, ona denk ve yeterli bir karşılık vermektir. Ödüllendirme, olumsuz yaptırım ve öç alma bu çekirdeğin yön ya da kullanım bakımından özelleşmiş görünümleridir.

facets.statement: Yapılan eylem, niteliğine uygun ve onu karşılayacak bir iyilik ya da kötülükle yanıtlanır.
Olumlu yönde ödül, olumsuz yönde ise yaptırım ya da öç biçiminde gerçekleşebilir.
Hızlı öç almayı ve övgüye değer işlerle yerine getirilmesi gereken yükümlülüklerin karşılıklarını anlatan özel kullanımlar da bu çekirdeğe bağlıdır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynakların ortak çizgisi, karşılığın yapılan işe denk düşmesi ve hem iyi hem kötü yönde olabilmesidir; ödül ile yaptırım bu ortak yapının karşıt yönleridir.

concept_gloss.text: iyiliğe ya da kötülüğe denk karşılık verme
concept_gloss.applicability: Eylemin niteliğine göre iki yönlü karşılık verme çekirdeğini bir arada anlatan genel kavram karşılığıdır.

error_profile.preserves: Eylem, denklik ve olumlu ya da olumsuz karşılık bileşenlerinin tümünü korur.

error_profile.preserves: Yapılan eylem ile karşılığın olumlu ya da olumsuz yönü arasındaki bağı korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Karşılığın iyi ya da kötü yönünün bağlamdan açıkça anlaşıldığı akıcı cümlelerde uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Yapılan eylem ile ona verilen denk karşılık arasındaki temel ilişkiyi korur.
error_profile.loses: Karşılığın hem iyi hem kötü yönde gerçekleşebileceğini kendi başına açıkça söylemez.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal, bir yapanın eylemine iyilik ya da kötülükle karşılık verilmesini öne çıkarır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal, sonucu kişinin kendi eyleminden yine kendisine dönen şey olarak çerçeveler.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal da iyi veya kötü bir eylemin, niteliğine uygun bir sonuçla karşılanmasını kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal karşılık verme ilişkisini anlatırken komşu dal yapılan işten doğup işi yapana geri dönen sonucu öne çıkarır; bu bakış ayrımı tam eşdeğerliği önler.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal hem iyiliğe verilen olumlu karşılığı hem kötülüğe verilen olumsuz karşılığı içerir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal yalnızca bir yanlışın ardından gelen olumsuz yaptırım ve öç yönüne bağlıdır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Olumsuz bir eyleme kötü karşılık verilmesi iki dalın kesiştiği alandır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Komşu dal odak dalın yalnızca olumsuz yönünü ve yanlış sonrasındaki yaptırımı kapsar; olumlu karşılık onun sınırları dışında kalır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dalda karşılık vermek yeterlidir; yarışma ya da üstün gelme gerekli değildir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dalda karşılıklı karşılık verme bir yarışmaya dönüşür ve taraflardan biri üstün gelir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da tarafların birbirine karşılık vermesi çevresinde kurulur.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Genel karşılık verme, üstün gelme sonucunu zorunlu kılmaz; komşu dal ise yalnızca bu yarışmalı ve sonuçta üstün gelinen özel kalıbı anlatır.

branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه الجزاء والمجازاة والمكافأة على الفعل بالخير أو الشر والثواب أو العقاب وما يجري مجرى إدراك الثأر وجوازي الأفعال
branches.what_is_not_ar: ليس قضاء الشيء عن غيره ولا الجزية ولا الجزء النصيب
branches.source_phrase_ar: جزى يجزي جزاء أي كافأ بالإحسان وبالإساءة (ayn)؛ جزيته بما صنع جزاء وجازيته (sihah)؛ الجزاء يكون ثوابا ويكون عقابا؛ جزيت فلانا بما صنع جزاء؛ جزاء العطاس؛ الجوازي معناها الجزاء (tahdhib)؛ الجزاء ما فيه الكفاية من المقابلة إن خيرا فخير وإن شرا فشر؛ جزيته بكذا وجازيته (mufradat)؛ مكافأته إياه؛ جزيت فلانا أجزيه جزاء وجازيته مجازاة (maqayis)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak sözü, bir şeyin ya da kişinin başkasının yerini tutmasını, onun adına işi görmesini ve yeterli olmasını ortak çekirdek olarak verir. İş görme, bir borcu ödeme ve bir edimin sahibi adına yeterli sayılması bu çekirdeğin özel uygulamalarıdır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Bu dal yapılan işe ödül ya da yaptırım vermeyi değil, başka birinin veya şeyin yerine geçerek yükümlülüğü karşılamayı anlatır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım, yerini tutma ve yeterli olma çekirdeğini genel biçimde verir; kişi, hayvan, iş, borç ve ödeme kalıplarını bu çekirdeğin ayrı uygulamaları olarak sınırlar.

concept_map.definition: Bir şeyin ya da kişinin başkasının yerini tutup onun adına bir işi veya yükümlülüğü karşılaması ve yeterli olmasıdır. İş görme, borç ödeme ve bir edimin sahibi adına yeterli sayılması bu çekirdeğin özel gerçekleşimleridir.

facets.statement: Bir şey ya da kişi başka birinin yerini tutar, onun yerine iş görür ve gereksinimi karşılar.
Bir işin, onu yapması gereken kimse adına tamamlanması yerini tutma çekirdeğinin bir uygulamasıdır.
Birinin alacağını veya borcunu ödemek ya da bir edimin sahibi adına yeterli sayılması da aynı çekirdeğe bağlıdır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar, yerini tutma ile yeterli olmayı tek yapıda birleştirir; başka biri adına iş görme, ödeme yapma ve yükümlülüğü karşılama bu yapının uygulamalarıdır.

concept_gloss.applicability: Bir şeyin ya da kişinin başkası adına yeterli olması ve gereken işi onun yerine görmesi çekirdeğini anlatır.

error_profile.preserves: Yerini tutma, başkası adına iş görme ve yeterli olma bileşenlerini birlikte korur.

contextual_glosses.text: onun yerine işi görüp yeterli olma
contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir kişi ya da şeyin başkasının yerini aldığı ve gereken işi karşıladığı bağlamlarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Başkasının yerini tutma, onun adına iş görme ve yeterli olma ilişkisini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Yerini tutma çekirdeğinin bir alacak veya borç ödemesiyle gerçekleştiği dar bağlamlarda uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Bir yükümlülüğün asıl kişi yerine başkası tarafından karşılanmasını korur.
error_profile.loses: Ödeme dışındaki işlerde yerini tutma ve genel yeterlilik kapsamını dışarıda bırakır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dalda bir nesne, ödeme ya da edim de başkasının yerini tutabilir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal yalnızca bir kişinin başka bir kişi adına görev üstlenmesine odaklanır.

neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Kişisel görev üstlenme ortak olsa da odak dalın nesne, ödeme ve yeterli sayılan edimlere uzanan kapsamı komşu dalda yoktur.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal, ödemenin veya edimin başka biri ya da şey adına yeterli olup onun yerini tutmasını gerektirir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal, alacağın ya da emanetin doğrudan ve eksiksiz biçimde ödenmesine odaklanır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal, bir şeyin başkası adına yeterli olup onun yerini tutmasını anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal, yapılan eylemin iyi ya da kötü bir karşılıkla yanıtlanmasını anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dalda da bir işin ardından onu karşılayan başka bir edim bulunabilir.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak sözü, bir borcun ödenmesini borçludan istemeyi ve alacağı elde etmeyi açıkça bildirir; aynı kullanım, bunu yapan kimsenin adlandırılmasını da içerir. Bu nedenle geçici çerçeve kaynakla uyumludur.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal borcu başkası adına ödemeyi değil, borçludan ödemesini istemeyi ve alacağı elde etmeyi anlatır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım, borcu isteme kalıbı ile bu işi yapan kişiyi bildiren biçimi ayrı tutar; bunlardan genel bir çıplak kök anlamı çıkarmaz.

concept_map.definition: Bir borcun ödenmesini borçludan istemek ve alacağı ondan talep etmektir. Aynı anlam alanı, alacağını isteyen veya borcun ödenmesini talep eden kişi için kullanılan adı da kapsar.

facets.statement: Alacaklı, borçludan borcunu ödemesini ister ve alacağını ondan talep eder.
Borcu isteyen ya da alacağın ödenmesini talep eden kişi bu eyleme bağlı özel bir adla anılır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak sözü, tarihsel bir yönetim düzeninde koruma statüsü verilen inanç topluluklarından alınan belirli vergiyi açıkça tanımlar. Adın açıklaması konusunda biri yükümlülüğün ödenmesini, diğeri can güvenliği karşılığında yeterli sayılmasını öne çıkaran iki görüş bulunur; ikisi de dalın vergi kimliğini değiştirmez.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal genel vergi ya da herhangi bir pay değildir; belirli bir tarihsel koruma statüsüne bağlı mali yükümlülüktür.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım doğrudan bu tarihsel vergi türünü verir ve kapsamını başka vergi, pay veya genel karşılık anlamlarıyla genişletmez.

concept_map.definition: Tarihsel bir yönetim düzeninde koruma statüsü verilen başka inanç topluluklarından alınan belirli bir vergidir. Adlandırılması, kaynaklarda ya yükümlülüğün ödenmesiyle ya da can güvenliğinin sürmesi karşılığında yeterli sayılmasıyla açıklanır.

facets.statement: Vergi, tarihsel olarak yönetim altında koruma statüsü verilen başka inanç topluluklarından alınır.
Adın gerekçesi, bir açıklamada borç sayılan yükümlülüğün ödenmesine, diğerinde can güvenliği karşılığında yeterli sayılmasına bağlanır.
Sözcüğün çoğul biçimi aynı türdeki vergileri topluca gösterir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar verginin kimliği ve kimlerden alındığı konusunda birleşir; adlandırmayı ise yükümlülüğün ödenmesi veya can güvenliği karşılığında yeterli sayılma üzerinden iki ayrı biçimde açıklar.

facets.statement: Sözlüksel olarak sınırlı, belirli bir yer adını bildirir.
Yer, rivayette son zamanda ortaya çıkacağı söylenen aldatıcı kişinin çıkışıyla ilişkilendirilir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar bu birimi belirli bir yer adı olarak verir ve rivayete göre son zamanda ortaya çıkacağı söylenen aldatıcı kişinin oradan çıkacağını aktarır.

concept_gloss.text: rivayette bir çıkış yeri olarak anılan yer adı
concept_gloss.applicability: Özel adın kendisini uydurmadan, yer olma çekirdeğini ve ona bağlanan rivayet bilgisini birlikte açıklar.

error_profile.preserves: Yer adı niteliğini ve rivayetteki çıkış yeri ilişkisini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Yalnızca sözlüksel türü açıklamak ve rivayet ayrıntısını bağlamda ayrıca vermek için uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Birimin belirli bir yeri adlandırdığını korur.
error_profile.loses: Yere bağlanan çıkış rivayetini tek başına aktaramaz.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak anlatımı, keskinlik veya iş görme gücünün azalmasıyla insanın, hayvanın, rüzgarın ve duyuların yorulmasını aynı çekirdekte toplar. Verilen dal bu ortak güçten düşme sınırını doğru biçimde yansıtır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Bu dal bütünlük bildiren kullanımları ve mirasla ilgili akrabalık anlamını kapsamaz.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım yalın güçten düşme anlamını kapsar; bineği yorma anlamı ise yalnız belirtilen ettirgen söz öbeğine bağlıdır.

concept_map.definition: Bir insanın, hayvanın, aracın, organın ya da etkin gücün keskinliğini, dayanma gücünü veya iş görme yetisini yitirerek körelmesi ya da yorulmasıdır. Bineği bu duruma düşürme, ayrıca belirli bir ettirgen söz öbeğinde anlatılır.

facets.statement: Keskinliğin, gücün veya iş görme yetisinin azalması temel anlamdır.
Yürüyen insanın ya da hayvanın yorulması ve kılıç, dil, bakış, işitme veya rüzgarın etkisizleşmesi bu çekirdeğin gerçekleşmeleridir.
Belirli ettirgen söz öbeği, kişinin bineğini yorup güçten düşürmesini anlatır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar, yorulma ile keskinliğini veya etkinliğini yitirmeyi ortak bir güçten düşme alanında birleştirir; kullanım insan, hayvan, kılıç, dil, bakış, işitme ve rüzgar gibi farklı taşıyıcılara uzanır.

concept_gloss.applicability: Keskinlik, dayanma gücü veya etkinlik kaybının birlikte anlatıldığı dal çekirdeğine uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Hem körelmeyi hem de yorularak güçten düşmeyi korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: İnsan veya hayvanın yürüme ve çalışma sonucu güçten düştüğü bağlamlarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Canlı taşıyıcının yorulma ve güç kaybını eksiksiz korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Kılıç, dil, bakış veya başka bir etkin yetinin keskinliğini yitirdiği bağlamlara uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Keskinlik ve etkinlik kaybını doğal bir Türkçe karşılıkla korur.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Kılıç, dil, duyu ve rüzgar gibi taşıyıcılarda keskinlik veya etkinlik kaybını da kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal da yürüme sonucunda insanın veya hayvanın yorulup güçten düşmesini anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Komşu dal bedensel yorgunlukla sınırlıyken bu dal, aynı güç kaybını araçların keskinliği ile dilin ve duyuların etkinliğine de taşır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Kılıç, dil ve rüzgarın etkisizleşmesi bu dalda açıkça yer alır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Gücün tümüyle tükenmesi, bıkkınlık ve eldekinin bitmesi komşu dalın ek kapsamıdır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal yorgunluk, bakışın zayıflaması ve gücün kesilmesi alanında örtüşür.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dal körelme ile yorulmayı geniş bir taşıyıcı dizisine uygular; komşu dal ise tükenme, kesilme ve bıkkınlık sonucunu daha belirgin kılar.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Adayların tümü değerlendirildi; yalnız bedensel yorgunluk ve güç tükenmesiyle gerçek anlam örtüşmesi kuran iki komşu yayımlandı, aynı kökün öteki eşsesli dalları ayrım sağlamadığı için alınmadı.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه كلال السيف واللسان والطرف والسمع والبصر، وإعياء الماشي والبعير والراحلة والريح
branches.what_is_not_ar: لا يدخل فيه الكُلّ بمعنى الإحاطة ولا الكَلالة في الميراث
branches.source_phrase_ar: خلاف الحدة وكل السيف واللسان والطرف (maqayis)؛ الكليل السيف الذي لا حد له ولسان كليل والكال المعيي (ayn)؛ كللت من المشي وكل السيف والريح والطرف واللسان (sihah)؛ الكليل السيف ولسان كليل والكال المعيي وثقل سمعه وكل بصره (tahdhib)؛ كل الرجل في مشيته والسيف عن ضريبته واللسان عن الكلام (mufradat)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak sözü, başkasının bakımına ve geçimine yük olan kişiyi çekirdek yapar; yetim, yakın desteği bulunmayan kişi ve bakmakla yükümlü olunan kimse bu alanda sayılır. Dal kullanılabilir, ancak bütün bu kişileri özleri gereği değersizleştiren bir niteleme gibi okunmamalıdır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Buradaki ağırlık fiziksel ağırlık değil, bir başkasının üstlendiği bakım ve geçim yüküdür.

lexicalization_scope.note: Yalın ad bağımlı kişiyi veya yükü bildirir; akrabaların kişiye yük olması gibi okumalar yalnız verilen söz öbeklerine bağlı tutulur.

concept_map.definition: Bakımı, geçimi veya taşınması başkasının sorumluluğuna yük olan kişi ya da şeydir. Yetim, çocuğu bulunmayan kişi veya hem çocuğu hem de ebeveyni bulunmayan kişi gibi geleneksel adlandırmalar ile akrabaların birine bağımlı hale gelmesi bu çekirdeğe bağlı özel kullanımlardır.

facets.statement: Bir kişi ya da şeyin bakım, geçim veya taşıma bakımından başkasına yük olması çekirdektir.
Yetim, çocuğu bulunmayan kişi veya hem çocuğu hem ebeveyni bulunmayan kişi kanıta bağlı özel referanslardır.
Taşınan tapınma nesnesi ve geçimi bir kişiye kalan akrabalar, bağımlılık ilişkisinin söz öbeğine bağlı örnekleridir.
Kaynak anlatımında ağır tabiatlı kişi ve başkası adına iş gören kişi de bu adlandırmanın çevresinde anılır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Ortak çekirdek, geçimi veya bakımı bir başkasının üzerinde kalan bağımlı kişi ya da şeydir. Yetim, çocuğu bulunmayan kişi ve hem çocuğu hem ebeveyni bulunmayan kişi öne çıkan özel durumlar, taşınan nesne ile geçimi üstlenilen akrabalar ise ilişkiyi somutlaştıran kullanımlardır. Bir kaynak, ağır tabiatlı kişiyi ve başkası adına iş gören kişiyi de bu adlandırma çevresinde anar.

concept_gloss.applicability: Geçim, bakım veya taşıma sorumluluğunun başka bir kişiye düştüğü çekirdek ilişkiye uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Bağımlı olan tarafı ve yükü üstlenen başka tarafı birlikte korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir kimsenin geçimini sağlamak zorunda olduğu aile veya yakınlar için uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Bakım sorumluluğunu ve bağımlı kişiler topluluğunu açıkça korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Yetim veya doğrudan aile desteğinden yoksun kişi için açıklayıcı bağlamlarda kullanılabilir.

error_profile.preserves: Kişinin yakın desteğinden yoksun olma özelliğini korur.

yetim veya yakın aile desteği bulunmayan kişi
